questions.question_english:
65. Evaluate the following statements regarding the
National Career Service (NCS) portal:
A. It is implemented by the Ministry of Labour
and Employment.
B. It has replaced the traditional network of
Employment Exchanges with a digital framework.
C. It provides job matching, career counseling,
and vocational guidance services.

portal to cover unorganized workers.

questions.explanation_english:
The National Career Service portal, implemented
by the Ministry of Labour and Employment,
modernized employment exchanges into a
digital platform. NCS provides job matching,
career counseling, vocational guidance, and skill
mapping services. Furthermore, its integration
with the e-Shram portal enables unorganized
workers to access formal job opportunities and
career support, confirming that all four listed
assertions are completely accurate and correct.

questions.question_english:
15. Evaluate the following statements regarding the DigiLocker platform:
A. DigiLocker offers 1 GB of secure cloud storage space for each account holder.
B. Documents issued in DigiLocker are considered equivalent to original physical documents under Rule 9A of the IT Rules, 2016.
C. DigiLocker utilizes the Aadhaar identity system for user authentication.
D. DigiLocker permits users to upload self-signed digital documents.

questions.explanation_english: DigiLocker provides users with 1 GB of secure cloud storage linked to their Aadhaar identity. Users authenticate using Aadhaar and can also upload self-signed digital files. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। DigiLocker उपयोगकर्ताओं को 1 जीबी सुरक्षित क्लाउड स्टोरेज प्रदान करता है जो उनके आधार पहचान से जुड़ा होता है। सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी नियम 2016 के नियम 9A के तहत DigiLocker में जारी किए गए इलेक्ट्रॉनिक दस्तावेज़ों को भौतिक दस्तावेज़ों के समान कानूनी स्थिति प्राप्त है। उपयोगकर्ता आधार का उपयोग करके प्रमाणित होते हैं और स्व-हस्ताक्षरित डिजिटल फ़ाइलें भी अपलोड कर सकते हैं। चूंकि सभी चार बयानों ने प्लेटफ़ॉर्म के प्रशासनिक और कानूनी मानकों का सही वर्णन किया है, सभी सूचीबद्ध बयान सही हैं।
